basic_profile.bio: A passionate tabletop gamer based in Round Rock, Texas, I’ve been a part of the Reddit community for over five years. My interests revolve around miniature wargaming, particularly Blood Bowl, and I'm always on the lookout for the latest updates and releases in the tabletop gaming world. I work as a software developer for a gaming company, which allows me to merge my love for tech and gaming. I'm in a long-term relationship, and we often play board games together during weekends. Typically, you'll find me online during evenings after work, where I engage in discussions on various subreddits.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in software development, having studied Computer Science at university. My passion for tabletop games started in college, where I joined a gaming club and quickly got hooked on Blood Bowl. Over the years, I’ve learned a lot about game design and strategy through both formal education and self-teaching. I also keep up with industry news and trends to inform my gaming strategies.
